messages:
sam: Hey team — FjordML wants a short POC to validate latency and burst behavior for a conversational embedding+rerank flow. They want numbers for sustained qps, 99th pct tail, and cold-start impact. Can we sync on a minimal run plan?

leah: timeline? they said next-week window (Tue/Wed).

sam: yea Tue morning preferred. Target workload: mixed chat + embed calls, ~30% embed (larger payloads), 70% chat. Peak target 300 qps sustained for 20m, microbursts to 1200 qps for ~30s. p95 target 250ms for chat, p95 400ms for embed.

mike: ok. A few quick q's: 1) model variants (quantized) for cost checks, 2) are they ok with regional failover? 3) do we simulate client retries/backoff?

zara: for model, suggest llama-2-70b-quant (or smaller 13b if cost constrained). Bursts will change kv cache hit rates — need to include warmup.

sam: FjordML prefers the 70b for quality. They asked if we can show impact of enabling prefix caching + batching. Include both configs.

solutions-eng: I'll spin up a dedicated run in our dedicated pool. Plan: two runs back-to-back — (A) cold (no cache, fresh workers), (B) warm (primed cache + batching=auto). Each run: 25m steady-state at 300 qps, 3x 30s microbursts at 1200 qps. We'll capture p50/p95/p99, and tokens/sec, GPU utilization, and observed batch size distribution.

ops-bot: deploy-bench-run started by solutions-eng — run_id=run-4812345987-1

mike: logging + metrics: please add these to the trace: route=chat/embed, model_variant, batch_size, kv_hit (bool), request_size_tokens. Also export client-side latencies so we can see network vs server.

jordan: security note from FjordML: they need assurance on no logs retention beyond 7 days, and KMS for keys. Also SSO + SCIM for any console access. Do we have a short answer for that?

leah: yes — private deployment options support customer-managed KMS, SCIM SSO, and we can set log retention policy. I'll draft the security summary.

zara: small test harness snippet to repro load (use vegeta for the embed path):

```
echo '{"input":"<long document>"}' | vegeta attack -rate=300 -duration=25m | vegeta report
```

sam: good. Also include a synthetic client with exponential backoff to mimic their SDK retries. We should run one baseline without client retries to measure raw server behavior.

solutions-eng: results (quick snapshot):

```
Run A (cold): p50_chat=120ms, p95_chat=480ms, p99_chat=980ms, p95_embed=860ms, GPU_util=62% avg, avg_batch=1.8
Run B (warm, caching): p50_chat=95ms, p95_chat=210ms, p99_chat=420ms, p95_embed=320ms, GPU_util=78% avg, avg_batch=5.2
Bursts: small tail spikes during first 10s of each microburst in Run A (~1.8-2x p95). Run B handled microbursts smoothly.
```

mike: those deltas look great — caching + batching reduce tail by ~2x for chat and ~2.6x for embed. We'll convert to charts for the deck.

jordan: cost ask from FjordML: can we provide a rough per-1M-token cost for each config (cold vs warm)?

leah: quick back of envelope: cold ~ $X/1M (higher since batching poor), warm ~ $0.72X/1M. I'll run more exact calc after we pull token counts from the traces.

sam: blockers to share with sales: 1) FjordML asked about PCI scope — they want a notes doc on network egress and shared tenancy. 2) KMS integration timeline. 3) A short SLA note for burst SLA.

solutions-eng: will prepare a short deliverable: a one-pager with: test summary, key metrics, cost estimates, configuration diffs, and a runbook for reproducing. Aim to have it by EOD Monday.

mike: assign me for charts + cost calc. jordan take security summary. leah draft the runbook steps. sam will coordinate the customer readout.

sam: thanks — ping me in #sales if any urgent drifts. :thumbsup:
